caption: The drawing depicts a central female figure, adorned in a red dress with a green mantle draped over her shoulders. She has brown hair and is standing inside an arched niche. The background within the niche is a light beige or tan color, and the arch itself is bordered by decorative red, green, and brown patterns, including floral designs on either side at the top. The niche is framed by two columns, one on each side, and the figure is illuminated by a large, circular gold halo with radiating lines around her head. The base of the niche is rectangular, shaded in reddish-brown with touches of yellow, mirroring the frame at the top. There is some handwriting or inscription on either side of the figure within the niche area, and the whole composition is centered against a plain, cream-colored background. The colors used are primarily red, green, brown, beige, gold, and black.
title: Santos Retablos
